load_cityscapes_instances: load cityscapes instance segmentation annotations from image and ground truth directories into Detectron2 format dicts
load_cityscapes_semantic: load cityscapes semantic segmentation file paths and metadata from image and ground truth directories
_cityscapes_files_to_dict: parse cityscapes annotation files into a single Detectron2 dataset dict with annotations and bounding boxes
_get_cityscapes_files: scan cityscapes directory structure and return tuples of image, instance, label, and json file paths
test_cityscapes_loader: test the cityscapes dataset loader module by loading instance or semantic annotations and visualizing results
